label: neiso 17 mystic cod
definition: neiso 16 (ct_deploy keeper) + the within-window fleet-exit fix: whole plants that ran during the window and retired before the single recent EIA-860 operable vintage (2025ER) were absent from EVERY modeled year, so survivors over-dispatched to cover them. The textbook case is Mystic (plant 1588, ~1.4 GW Boston/NEMA CC, ~1.3 TWh in 2023, retired Jun 2024). Fix injects these exits from the final-vintage 'Retired and Canceled' sheets (cod_ramp + a backcast-only loader, mirror of planned additions) and caps each by its observed CEMS outages. Result: Mystic now dispatches 0.72 TWh 2023 / 0.85 TWh Jan-Jun 2024 in Boston, zero 2025; the modeled CC_REGULAR plant set differs by year (31/31/29, was 29 every year); total CC_REGULAR stays in tolerance (-0.2/-0.2/+8.7% vs EIA-923) and the run is gas-neutral (54.8/58.9/60.1) and level-neutral (34.5/39.8/70.5 vs DA 36.8/41.5/67.9) vs neiso 16. Mystic's 0.72 vs 1.31 actual is the reliability/RMR dispatch the economic LP cannot recover (same class as the CT/ST/oil wedge); 2025 +8.7% CC is the separate merit-order issue, untouched.
